config.noise_recipe: NumPy standard_normal float64; normalize each window draw to RMS=1 without removing sample mean; multiply by original-window RMS * 10**(-snr_db/20); add before saved preprocessing
config.signal_power_definition: mean(original_window**2), including DC; original recorded background is part of the reference signal
config.pairing: same noisy array for CNN and SVM; same noise direction across SNR levels within each seed
config.aggregation: mean and population std (ddof=0) of three noise-draw metrics; not a confidence interval or independent-device sample count
config.sample_audit_rule: Within the fixed detailed case, first union-error per true class; if that class has no error, first correct window. Visualization only, no model selection.
config.clean_load_audit: 0/1 HP are fitted training data, 2 HP is used validation, 3 HP is reused test; no leave-one-load-out retraining
config.known_reuse: Same records as the clean evaluation; evaluation stress experiment only, no tuning, retraining, denoising, or actual field noise validation
